text:
Ava (CFO): Thanks for joining the AH. Dropping a short thread for budget/runway follow-ups and procurement clarifications. Please keep questions brief and well answer inline.

nina (eng): Is runway still reported as months at current burn or do you factor in hiring plans?

Ava (CFO): We report "months at projected burn". That includes cash on hand divided by projected monthly outflows. Projected outflow = payroll + benefits + approved hires (offers accepted) ramped in by start month + committed contracts amortized across their term. We smooth with a 3mo trailing average.

leo (prod): The dedicated infra commit we discussed last week  included?

Ravi (Finance Ops): It's included only after a PO is issued or a signed contract is recorded. In negotiation = excluded.

olivia (procurement): Quick note on timelines: We're piloting a "fast-track" onboarding for infra and strategic cloud partners. Target turnaround 7 business days if vendor provides standard security docs and a clean MSA. Use the "fast-track" label on the Jira request.

nina (eng): Where do we submit?

payments-bot: Submit vendor onboarding -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/QuickCreate choose 'Vendor Onboarding' and add label: fast-track. Status updates will post into #vendors.

Ava (CFO): Policy bullets: P-card limits: engineers $2k, managers $10k. Any single spend > $50k requires Finance + Legal pre-approval (PO). Capital vs expense classification follows capex policy; check with Finance Ops.

leo (prod): Small SaaS trials < $500 ok to self-approve?

Ravi (Finance Ops): Yes for trials <$500/mo, but register them in the tracker so we avoid duplicate costs. If it converts to >$500/mo within 90 days, raise a ticket. Form: https://forms.gle/rdw-small-saas

nina (eng): Vendor asks for a big upfront setup fee that pushes us over $50k. Do we pause?

Ava (CFO): If it's customer-impacting or critical for uptime, open an "Emergency Spend" ticket, tag @Ava and @Ravi with vendor and reason. We can approve same-day in rare cases. Otherwise, wait for PO.

Sofia (People): Reminder: any contract tied to headcount must include People in approvals so we can capture start dates and ramp for forecasting.

Ravi (Finance Ops): Posted short explainer: https://drive.redwood.com/finance/projected-burn-qna (includes formula, inputs, and smoothing).

olivia (procurement): Ill drop a 1-pager fast-track checklist and the Jira templates in #vendors after lunch. Tag me on tickets you want prioritized.

Ava (CFO): If anyone is blocked on a vendor, reply here with vendor name + Jira ID and we'll triage. Thanks — keeping this thread as the canonical follow-up. :white_check_mark:
